smoke.r_b_definition: mean over seeds 0 and 5 of rows(RB6)/rows(A0) on the smoke decisions

projections.basis: smoke planner seconds scaled by games (BF48 x 50/3, FH-DP x 10); caps from the registration

runtime_ledger.location: process memory (MemoryLedger sink; no file opened)

smoke.post_sealing_measurements: in the terminal receipt (seconds_total, utc, peak RSS)

seeds.rule: planning_seed(state, support, seed) per decision; FH-DP has no seed

limits: Stability of the planning law only; no policy value, OPE or recommendation-quality estimate
DEV July-September 2025 is exposed development data (no outcome read here)
0.95, 0.02, 4x, the gap bins, budgets and tolerances are judgement values (D186 approved the three thresholds); costs are Mac mini CPU measurements, not service latency guarantees
peak_rss_bytes_process_lifetime is ru_maxrss: the peak of the whole process, so a later pass in the same process inherits the peak of an earlier one
RB / BF48 / FH-DP planners are diagnostics, not a registered policy identity (c13cc989 unchanged)

k_c.note: cheapest measured K in {3, 5} with K >= r_rows; not an equal-cost comparison

RB6_0.note: descriptive ratio, not an additive share

RB6_5.note: descriptive ratio, not an additive share

REF_100.note: descriptive ratio, not an additive share

secondary_flags.note: descriptive; never a verdict input (H2 is empirical)
